G001.target_statement: Find a flight itinerary whose departure, arrival and connection times fit his onward transport, hotel needs and the schedules of the people he is meeting.
G001.label: direct
G001.rationale: T119 逐项列出中转衔接、与接送及会面对象时间匹配、时段是否合适；T031 说明到达时间会影响是否需要订酒店。主体、对象与条件均取自原句，未把例子固化为固定业务目标。
supported_parts: 到达时间影响住宿安排

G002.target_statement: Find the best available fare for the itinerary he has chosen.
G002.label: direct
G002.rationale: T025 把拿到好价格列为主要关注点，T115 把好价格列为三大目标之一；无量化阈值，未编造阈值。
supported_parts: 价格需与所选行程匹配

G003.target_statement: Compare the booking providers offered for a shortlisted itinerary and choose the one with the lowest final price and best terms.
G003.label: direct
G003.rationale: T077 描述逐家点击进入核对价格、评分与折扣，T115 明确把比较预订网站列为三大目标之一。

G004.target_statement: Search many origin, destination, date and cabin combinations at the same time to find the best option.
G004.label: direct
G004.rationale: T095 与 T099 明确表达希望同时铺开数百次、上万种组合的检索；数量来自受访者本人举例。
supported_parts: 覆盖机场、日期、舱位维度

G005.target_statement: Stay logged out and anonymous while searching for flights on the aggregator.
G005.label: direct
G005.rationale: T053 明确避免登录并尽量匿名，T093 表示大概率永不登录；强度按原话保留，并未升级为绝对禁止。

G006.target_statement: Keep his personal data from being collected or shared by the flight search and booking sites.
G006.label: direct
G006.rationale: T089 直接表达不希望数据被共享，T091 把信任列为对该类应用的重要要求；这是态度而非已验证事实。
supported_parts: 隐私与信任是重要考量

G007.target_statement: Be alerted when fares on the specific routes he is watching drop, so that he can book at the lower price.
G007.label: direct
G007.rationale: T087 叙述实际设置过多条航线提醒并说明用途；T085 同时表达对可行性怀疑，因此目标限定为'对已关注航线收到降价提醒'，未扩展为通用预测。

G008.target_statement: Book one to one-and-a-half months before departure to obtain a better fare.
G008.label: direct
G008.rationale: T015 给出明确时间范围与目的（更好价格），并用 mostly/at least 表达强度。

G009.target_statement: Search by country or region instead of a single airport so that many airports are covered in one query.
G009.label: direct
G009.rationale: T065 说明改用国家/区域以便一次查询覆盖更多机场，属于自述做法与目的。

G010.target_statement: Restrict search results to his preferred departure and arrival windows and to a maximum number of hours in the air.
G010.label: direct
G010.rationale: T069 说明只在衔接时使用筛选，并给出两个具体限定（起降时段、空中时长上限）；'rarely' 的使用频率未改写为强制。

G011.target_statement: Rule out itineraries with 40 to 60 hours of total travel even when they are the cheapest listed.
G011.label: direct
G011.rationale: T073 说明宁可不选 40-60 小时的超长行程，即使它们最便宜；强度为 would rather not，未写成绝对禁止。

G012.target_statement: Allow at least 1.5 to 2 times the airport's minimum connection time at each connection.
G012.label: direct
G012.rationale: T123 给出明确倍数与目的（安全余量、应对延误），并说明签证例外。

G013.target_statement: Check whether the lounge at the connection airport is open at the connection time.
G013.label: direct
G013.rationale: T123 自述把休息室开放时间作为选择中转的一个因素，并说明动机是走访休息室。
supported_parts: 查询中转机场休息室开放时间

G014.target_statement: Have his card-based lounge entitlements kept up to date in one place and shown alongside the flight search.
G014.label: direct
G014.rationale: T125 明确说若能整合到 Skyscanner '会很好'；同一段又说第三方更新不准、他更信任源头，因此可靠性条件写入 context，未把愿望升级为必须。
supported_parts: 希望权益信息集中且与检索整合

G015.target_statement: Show whether a fare is above or below the median for markets he is unfamiliar with.
G015.label: direct
G015.rationale: T109 说明用中位价判断陌生市场价格高低，T111 明确说在 Skyscanner 上也显示会 helpful 且是 nice to have。
supported_parts: 陌生市场的中位价对比

G016.target_statement: Cut the time spent researching flights while covering more combinations.
G016.label: direct
G016.rationale: T137 把研究耗时列为最大障碍，T149 明确若能用更少时间检索更多组合就愿意迁移；条件是长期使用。

G017.target_statement: Log in to the airline loyalty account to check award-seat availability and book a points ticket.
G017.label: direct
G017.rationale: T055/T057 说明奖赏座位只能在登录后的航空公司网站查看与预订，是这一出票方式的必要步骤。
supported_parts: 里程票须登录航司账户
在该渠道查看余位并出票

G018.target_statement: Take routings with extra stops and lounge visits when he travels for pleasure and is not pressed for time.
G018.label: direct
G018.rationale: T019 明确说会为体验选择更多中转与世界最长航线，并说尽量最大化空中时间；这是旅行偏好，条件限定为度假且时间宽裕。

G019.target_statement: Keep using the aggregator interface he already knows so that each search takes less time.
G019.label: direct
G019.rationale: T105 与 T147 说明熟悉界面是继续用 Skyscanner 的实际理由，并量化了切换多花的时间。

G020.target_statement: Find the best flight option for a planned cash booking through research on aggregators.
G020.label: direct
G020.rationale: T115 把研究并找出可用行程与价格列为第一目标，T129 复述研究环节要看的东西；上层目标由原文自述支撑，不是为凑层级新增。
supported_parts: 以研究确定最优预订方案

G021.target_statement: Prefer flight times that let him sleep at night over red-eye departures.
G021.label: direct
G021.rationale: T119 用 would rather 表达偏好，同时承认可接受红眼；未升级为禁止。
